nodes.name: trending-sounds-library.md
nodes.summary: Reference library catalog of trending sounds for viral video templates, used as static documentation for the trends/audio research workflow.

nodes.name: virallab_sandbox.json
nodes.summary: Postman environment definition exposing sandbox base URL and auth tokens for testing the ViralLab API.

nodes.name: trendzo.js
nodes.summary: Browser-side Trendzo SDK that exposes window.TrendzoSDK with pixel() and telemetry() helpers, posting to /api/pixel/collect and /api/telemetry/ingest via sendBeacon with fetch fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE pattern with sendBeacon-first transport for reliable unload-time delivery; reads template/sku/campaign data attributes off the loading <script>.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: Manifest describing the ryos-like sound pack (id, title, BPM, hot-zone timings) consumed by the audio-driven video editor.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: Manifest for the default Trendzo sound pack defining BPM, sections, and metadata used by the beat-sync pipeline.

nodes.name: test-beat-info.txt
nodes.summary: Plain-text note describing the test beat asset (origin, BPM, intended use) bundled for beat-sync verification.

nodes.name: admin-dashboard.js
nodes.summary: Tiny client-side redirect shim that forwards browser navigation from /admin-dashboard.js to /admin-dashboard.html.

nodes.name: deploy-database.html
nodes.summary: Standalone admin HTML page used to drive Supabase database deployment / migration steps from the browser.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Static fallback landing HTML served from /public, primarily for environments not booted through the Next.js renderer.

nodes.name: verify-beat-sync.html
nodes.summary: Lightweight static page used to QA beat-sync timing of the audio packs against a reference waveform.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI entry point for the CleanCopy ML training microservice; exposes /train, /train/status, /predict, and /models endpoints that delegate to TrainingService.
nodes.languageNotes: Manually parses the Next.js .env.local at startup so the Python service shares the same Supabase / API credentials.

nodes.name: TrainRequest
nodes.summary: Pydantic request body for kicking off a training job, carrying a job_id and an optional training config dict.

nodes.name: PredictRequest
nodes.summary: Pydantic request body for /predict; carries a feature dict mapping feature names to float values.

nodes.name: start_training
nodes.summary: POST /train endpoint that schedules a TrainingService training run as a FastAPI BackgroundTask and returns the job_id.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Getting-started guide for the python-services FastAPI training microservice, covering setup, env vars, endpoints, and Docker run instructions.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Pinned Python dependency list for the FastAPI training service (FastAPI, uvicorn, XGBoost, scikit-learn, supabase, etc.).

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Builds the python-services container on python:3.11-slim, installing ffmpeg/OpenCV system libs, pip-installing requirements, and running uvicorn main:app on port 8000.
nodes.languageNotes: System packages (libgl1-mesa-glx, ffmpeg, libxrender) installed to support OpenCV and audio processing inside the container.

nodes.name: personal-finance-report.json
nodes.summary: Structured research report payload for the personal-finance niche, used as seed/reference data for niche-specific prediction tuning.

nodes.name: features.json
nodes.summary: Feature manifest for autoresearch experiment auto-001, listing the input columns used to train the candidate XGBoost model.

nodes.name: model.json
nodes.summary: Serialized XGBoost model payload for autoresearch experiment auto-001 (single-line JSON dump of the booster).

nodes.name: results.json
nodes.summary: Evaluation results for autoresearch experiment auto-001 — Spearman CV/holdout scores, MAE, hypothesis metadata, and feature importances.

nodes.name: scaler.json
nodes.summary: Serialized feature scaler (mean/std per column) used to normalize inputs before scoring with the auto-001 model.

nodes.name: features.json
nodes.summary: Feature manifest for autoresearch experiment auto-002 listing the columns fed into the candidate model.

nodes.name: model.json
nodes.summary: Serialized XGBoost model payload for autoresearch experiment auto-002.

nodes.name: results.json
nodes.summary: Evaluation results for autoresearch experiment auto-002 with cross-validation and holdout metrics plus the experiment hypothesis.

nodes.name: scaler.json
nodes.summary: Feature scaler artifact (per-column means and scales) paired with the auto-002 candidate model.
